overview: EasyBuy is an Expo React Native ecommerce app for browsing products, managing a cart and wishlist, placing cash-on-delivery orders, and administering users, products, categories, and order status. The repository also includes a local Express mock API that mirrors the backend contract used by the mobile app.

domain_models.name: User
domain_models.definition: Authenticated account returned from login or registration, carrying identity, userType, and token data for app navigation and API authorization.

domain_models.name: Admin
domain_models.definition: Privileged userType that can access the dashboard and manage products, categories, users, and orders.

domain_models.name: Product
domain_models.definition: Catalog item with title, SKU, price, stock quantity, description, image, and category metadata.

domain_models.name: Category
domain_models.definition: Product grouping used for catalog browsing and admin product classification.

domain_models.name: CartItem
domain_models.definition: Redux-managed product snapshot with selected quantity used to build checkout payloads.

domain_models.name: Order
domain_models.definition: Checkout result containing order id, user, line items, amount, payment type, shipping address, status, and timestamps.

domain_models.name: OrderItem
domain_models.definition: Line item in an order or checkout payload tying a product id to price and quantity.

domain_models.name: Wishlist
domain_models.definition: Authenticated user's saved product list for later purchase, managed through add and remove API operations.

domain_models.name: Session
domain_models.definition: Persisted auth user and token stored via SecureStore on native platforms and AsyncStorage on web.

domain_models.name: DashboardMetric
domain_models.definition: Admin summary counts for users, orders, products, and categories shown on dashboard cards.

domain_models.name: UploadedImage
domain_models.definition: Product image file uploaded through multipart form data and served from the backend uploads path.

domain_models.name: ShippingAddress
domain_models.definition: Checkout delivery location made from country, city, street address, and zipcode fields.
